### The Relationship Between Faith and Anxiety
Author: Melissa Fisher
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-16-2026.html
Passage: 1 Peter 5:7
Points:
- Anxiety often causes Christians to question their spiritual strength and feel distant from God.
- Believers do not need to resolve their anxiety before entering God's presence.
- God invites us to bring all our messy and overwhelming feelings directly to Him.
- Faith can continue to mature while learning to hand our anxieties over to Christ.
- Jesus willingly receives our heavy burdens and walks beside us with comfort and grace.

### Casting All Your Cares
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-may-24-2026.html
Passage: 1 Peter 5:6-7
Points:
- Rather than ignoring or fleeing from worry, Scripture commands us to decisively hurl our anxieties upon God.
- Clinging to worry is rooted in pride and a desire to control our own circumstances.
- Practicing biblical humility means acknowledging that the Father cares for us better than we can.
- Believers experience genuine peace and freedom when they surrender their heavy burdens into God's capable hands.
